limitations: Completed execution with unresolved final store hygiene: the fresh-boot assertion failed on a stale test draft/seed-files issue. The captured visible implementation is not acceptance for continued editing. One unrandomized shared-host execution; primary final-pixel inspection is representative rather than every matrix PNG. Original stalled image-return bytes remain unavailable; subsequent genuine observations are separately retained. Chromium and emulated viewports only; no physical-mobile keyboard, screen-reader session, injected server failure/retry, owner preference acceptance or natural-speed playback. Original theme settings copy remains English. Earlier incomplete-attempt records remain unchanged. Recorded completion is a post-resume export time, not engine completion or active duration. Resolved native model/role identities, tokens, billing and context metrics remain unavailable.
